source.title: Call for Applicants - Executive Assistants (April 2019)
source.content:
The WCA Board is creating a position to carry out the administrative tasks of the Board of Directors. To make the Board position more appealing to qualified Staff members, less time consuming, and sustainable in the long-term, they will appoint 2-3 Executive Assistants who will be responsible for assisting the Board members with day-to-day functions. 

Some sample tasks include:
- Managing the WCA Board’s Trello board
- Maintaining Policies, Bylaws, and Motions on Github
- Administration of users on G-Suite
- Administration of WCA Board’s Team Drives
- Drafting emails on behalf of the Board
- Compiling and reviewing information from form responses
<!-- break -->
Executive Assistants are expected to spend **at least 5 hours per week** on average to work for the Board. The position is open to everyone; it is not necessary to hold a current position within the WCA to be considered. The qualities expected of candidates are:
- Strong organizational skills
- Excellent communication skills
- Frequent availability
- Trustworthiness

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until **April 15th, 2019, 23:59 UTC** privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).

**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**
- Brief personal introduction
- Summary of activities done for the WCA Community
- Reasons you are fit for the role

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the Executive Assistants.

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: 执行助理招募（2019 年 4 月）
translation.content:
WCA 董事会正在设立一个负责董事会行政事务的职位。为让董事职位对符合条件的工作人员更有吸引力、减少工作耗时，并使董事会能够长期稳定运作，董事会将任命 2 至 3 名执行助理，协助董事处理日常事务。

工作可能包括：

- 管理 WCA 董事会的 Trello 看板。
- 在 GitHub 上维护政策、章程和动议。
- 管理 G-Suite 用户。
- 管理 WCA 董事会的团队云端硬盘。
- 代表董事会起草邮件。
- 汇总和审阅表单回复中的信息。

执行助理须平均**每周至少投入 5 小时**协助董事会工作。申请向所有人开放，不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

- 出色的组织能力。
- 出色的沟通能力。
- 经常有时间处理工作。
- 值得信赖。

申请现已开放，请于 **2019 年 4 月 15 日 23:59 UTC 前**，将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：**

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 为 WCA 社区所做工作的概述。
- 说明自己适合这一职位的原因。

申请截止后的下一周，WCA 董事会将投票选定并公布执行助理人选。

提前感谢大家的申请与支持！
